sources.title: openbmb/MiniCPM-V-4 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: The model is built based on SigLIP2-400M and MiniCPM4-3B with a total of 4.1B parameters. It inherits the strong single-image, multi-image and video understanding performance of MiniCPM-V 2.6 with largely improved efficiency.

sources.snippet: The most notable models in the series currently include: MiniCPM-V 4.6: 🔥🔥🔥 The latest and most efficient model in the MiniCPM-V series. With a total of 1.3B parameters, it surpasses larger models like Gemma4-E2B-it in performance, while showing superior efficiency than smaller models like Qwen3.5-0.8B (achieving ~1.5x token throughput).

sources.title: openbmb/MiniCPM-V-4_5-gguf - Secret AI
sources.snippet: Based on LLaVA-UHD architecture, MiniCPM-V 4.5 can process high-resolution images with any aspect ratio and up to 1.8 million pixels (e.g., 1344x1344), using 4x less visual tokens than most MLLMs. The model achieves leading performance on OCRBench, surpassing proprietary models such as GPT-4o-latest and Gemini 2.5.
